review.notes: All 34 physical pages were scanned against the PDF text layer with a normalized word-n-gram droppage probe plus targeted per-page checks; the three code fences are balanced; all section headings, figures and Tables 1-11 are present, and the two-column reference list (physical p.14-17) is complete. Dropped footnote bodies were the main defect class: the title-page symbol footnotes (p.1), the four source-URL footnotes (p.4), the paragraph-marked test-loss note (p.8) and the RLHFlow dataset URL footnote 11 (p.10) are restored from 300-dpi renders. OCR auto-corrections of the source's own misspellings were verified on renders and reverted ("has achieved" p.2, "querys" p.5, missing space in "andablation" p.8); the print's own heading typos "Dicussion"/"Limitaiton" (p.13), the spaced dataset name "pair_data_v2 800K wsafety" (p.10 body) and the appendix example dialogs are faithfully reproduced by the OCR and left unchanged. The Figures 11-12 evaluation-prompt transcripts are figure-internal text additionally transcribed as fenced blocks and were not treated as defects. Table cells were verified cell-by-cell only for Tables 1 and 10; the remaining tables matched at value-probe level.
